evaluation_policy: Every score must include dataset, index, retrieval mode, candidate budget and provenance.

runs.mode: hybrid
runs.caveat: Gold and routing cues are structurally related; not independent evaluation.

runs.mode: pending-execution
runs.caveat: Requires local index runtime; not independent human gold.

runs.mode: lexical/dense/hybrid-rrf-2to1
runs.caveat: 111 positive query instances (37 canonical groups x 3 regimes); partial-judgment precision/NDCG; query_parser filter mode best lexical. See reports/ranking/variant-regime-v1/analysis.md

runs.mode: rrf-weight-sweep (1:1 to 0:1)
runs.caveat: lexical-only (1:0) beats every fused weight in all regimes; per-regime best selected on eval set; default strategy changed to lexical. See reports/ranking/fusion-sweep-v1/analysis.md

runs.mode: cell-level extraction (regex baseline)
runs.caveat: 149 annotated cells across 8 tables; quarterly baseline 28/32; other table types unimplemented. See reports/ranking/table-eval-v1/analysis.md

runs.mode: lexical/dense/hybrid with rewrite none|deterministic|llm
runs.caveat: 36 OOV instances / 12 questions; LLM rewrite is the decisive lever (none 0.194 -> llm 0.694); hybrid remains worse than lexical; rewrites not yet persisted across runs. See reports/ranking/oov-eval-llm-v1/analysis.md

runs.mode: lexical/dense/hybrid with bge-small-zh-v1.5 dense
runs.caveat: bge-zh dense is worse than E5 in every regime (0.162/0.568/0.162 vs 0.216/0.703/0.189); Chinese-specific small model does not solve synonym gaps. See reports/ranking/variant-regime-bge-zh-v1/analysis.md

runs.mode: deterministic cell extraction (all four table types)
runs.caveat: 146/149 cells; sole residual is Yili segment '其他地区' where the PDF text layer dropped '地区' (gold from visual review). See reports/ranking/table-eval-v2/analysis.md

runs.mode: deterministic table answers wired into answer_generation
runs.caveat: No-LLM three lanes: Oracle 0.3143->0.6571, Retrieved 0.0857->0.2571, Robustness 0.2273->0.3636; zero regressions. Retrieved still misses 6 table items due to evidence not in top-5. See reports/generation/comparisons/*-table-v1

runs.mode: deepseek-chat three lanes + RAGAS after table path
runs.caveat: Oracle 0.9714 (flat, one-item swap), Retrieved 0.5429->0.5714, Robustness 0.5455->0.6364; RAGAS faithfulness up in all lanes; api_model metadata fixed (independent_judge=false correctly recorded). See reports/generation/comparisons/*-deepseek-table-v2

runs.mode: deepseek-chat three lanes with remote-abstention detection
runs.caveat: Retrieved strict 0.5714->0.8000 (+8 correctly-scored refusals, -0), Robustness 0.6364->0.8636 (+6, -1 artifact), Oracle 0.9429 (item-level variance); behavior is now measured honestly (0.8958/0.8276); hedged refusals containing numbers no longer score. See reports/generation/comparisons/*-abstain-v2

runs.mode: deepseek-chat three lanes with remote deterministic-table priority (controlled toggle)
runs.caveat: Single-variable experiment (FINDOC_RAG_REMOTE_DETERMINISTIC_TABLES=1): Oracle strict 0.9429->1.0, Retrieved 0.80->0.8286 (+1), Robustness 0.8636 flat; behavior 1.0/0.9583/0.8621; zero regressions; table-item refusals eliminated; runs carry code_revision. See reports/generation/comparisons/*-table-remote-v1

runs.mode: deepseek-chat three lanes with concentration table type (5th type)
runs.caveat: Robustness strict 0.8636->0.9545 (+2 concentration items) and behavior 0.8621->0.9655; Oracle 1.0; Retrieved flat (one unrelated model-variance behavior flip); extractor 8/8 cells on table-eval-concentration-v1; v1 run exposed and v2 fixed a query-company selection bug under negative-precedes-gold ordering. See reports/generation/comparisons/*-concentration-v2

runs.mode: retrieved lane LLM rewrite A/B (persistent cache)
runs.caveat: Negative result: strict flat (+1/-1), behavior -2 (variance), 38/48 evidence changed but 3 legacy retrieval misses unfixed and 3 new evidence regressions (revenue_yoy, disclosed_risks x2); RAGAS context relevance 0.973->0.892. LLM rewrite NOT adopted for the canonical retrieved lane; deterministic synonyms remain default. OOV benefit does not transfer to canonical queries.

runs.mode: coordinate-level reconstruction (whole-page blocks, no cropping)
runs.caveat: Synthetic fixtures 11/11 pass, but real whole-page input scores 92/157 (Recall 0.586) vs text baseline 154/157; not production-ready. Bottlenecks: table-region localization, segment section isolation, quarterly label-after-values pairing. Harness: scripts/evaluate_coordinate_reconstruction.py. See reports/ranking/table-reconstruction-v1/analysis.md

runs.mode: coordinate-level reconstruction v9 (region localization, page isolation, label repair)
runs.caveat: 92/157 -> 154/157 (Recall 0.981), matching the text baseline; sole residual is Yili segment '其他地区' (text-layer loss). Fixes: anchor last-match + tail exclusion, split-heading boundary, decimal-heading regex, quarterly label-tail repair, prose label filter, segment x-order columns, page-aware regions/bands. See reports/ranking/table-reconstruction-v1/analysis.md

runs.mode: chunk-grounded safe coordinate selection, source PDF and persisted IR v2 replay
runs.caveat: 157 predictions / 154 hits on both PDF and IR v2, versus raw 165 / 154. The selector does not read gold: it requires headers, unit, complete row-column bundles and source-chunk consistency. It removes 2 quarterly heading cells and 6 adjacent-table leaks. The remaining 3 cells are the frozen '其他地区' versus page/text-layer '其他' disagreement; no benchmark-specific relabeling is used. See coordinate-safe-v10-pdf and coordinate-safe-v10-ir.

runs.mode: asset integrity and Agent evidence contract
runs.caveat: Frozen questions, answers and primary metrics are unchanged. A 38-chunk minimal catalog covers 35 unique gold chunks and all 53 hard negatives; external SHA locks support clean-clone validation. Formal retrieved runs fail closed when the active index differs. Agent endpoints expose versioned query outcomes, route/filter/trace/index identities, dynamic capabilities, and index-bound evidence resolution with SHA-256. No new remote DeepSeek/RAGAS score is claimed.

runs.mode: explicit migration contract + lexical/dense/hybrid paired evaluation
runs.caveat: Canonical benchmark assets remain immutable. The manifest binds E5 revision 614241f..., model/embedding/BM25/sidecar checksums, snapshot c3f157..., and 38 judged chunks whose semantic cores are unchanged. Paired lexical results versus historical 10fb are identical on Hit/MRR for all 111 positive instances; semantic-regime Recall@5 improves +0.027 through the shared production query router. Dev fusion sweep with deterministic rewrite again selects lexical-only for every regime. This migration experiment itself makes no remote-score claim; the later deepseek-index-bound-final entry records the formal generation run.

runs.mode: index-bound structured-table sidecar with coordinate-safe extraction and text fallback
runs.caveat: The real 958-chunk corpus yields 15 tables / 195 cells: 12 coordinate-derived and 3 safety-gated text fallbacks. The sidecar binds schema/generator/index/source/content/chunk SHA and does not change chunk serialization or index identity. Frozen 157-cell evaluation remains 154 hits / 157 predictions. Three residual cells are the source text-layer '其他' versus provisional gold '其他地区'; no benchmark-specific relabeling.

runs.mode: DeepSeek Oracle/Retrieved/Robustness with index-bound structured routing and scope-adaptive candidate budget
runs.caveat: Strict denominators are 35/35/22, not all 48 items. Retrieved deterministic gold-context coverage is 37/37. RAGAS metric and complete-row coverage are 100%, but the judge is DeepSeek itself (independent_judge=false). Against each lane's historical best, Retrieved has 6 strict fixed / 0 regressed and Robustness has 1 / 0 (0.9545->1.0); the older Robustness table-remote comparison has 3 / 0 but is not the historical best. These comparisons include multiple engineering changes plus DeepSeek stochasticity and are not single-variable causal experiments. The earlier remote-v1 Oracle run with 43.75% item errors was a sandbox network-permission failure and is invalid.
